title: Professor of Decision and Information Sciences, Charlton College of Business, University of Massachusetts Dartmouth
bio: Faculty Professor of Decision and Information Sciences, Charlton College of Business, University of Massachusetts Dartmouth Education PhD, Wayne State University Education PhD, Wayne State University Dr. Bharatendra Rai is professor of business analytics in the Charlton College of Business at the University of Massachusetts, Dartmouth. He teaches courses on applied deep learning, analyzing big data, business analytics and data mining, applied decision techniques, and operations management.
